footer.moreOptionsHint: More options in the top-right user menu

timerControls.modeInfoTextBody: You type the time after solving and hit Enter. Classic, fine if you use a separate stopwatch.
timerControls.modeInfoWcaBody: Competition standard. Press Space to start inspection (15s), press + hold + release to start the solve. Press Space to stop. Penalty automatic (+2 from 15s, DNF from 17s).
timerControls.modeInfoPragmaticBody: Training-friendly. Single tap during inspection starts the solve, double-tap restarts inspection. Auto-DNF at countdown 0. A bit more relaxed than WCA.
timerControls.tipTouch: on phone, text input through the soft keyboard is a bit tedious — spacebar tap is usually faster.
timerControls.tipDesktop: Try the spacebar timer — much smoother training, including inspection countdown. Just click one of the spacebar modes above.

scramble.title: Scramble
scramble.infoBody1: Random twist sequence using WCA notation. Letters = face (R, L, U, D, F, B), prime ("L'") = counter-clockwise, digit 2 = double turn. Apply the scramble to a solved cube — then all solves are comparable under the same conditions. "Skip" generates a new one.
scramble.infoBody2: Default is the scramble that matches your selected cube type. Toggle "WCA" ↔ "Unofficial" + dropdown to choose another type. Switching the cube type resets the override automatically.
scramble.customButtonTitle: Type your own scramble (e.g. from another app / competition)
scramble.skipTitle: Skip this scramble, generate a new one
scramble.fromSessionOverride: From session override: "{{label}}" — pick a toggle to change
scramble.editPlaceholder: e.g. R U R' U' R' F R2 U' R' U' R U R' F'
scramble.editNoValidation: Input is not validated — make sure the notation matches the cube type yourself.
scramble.notAvailable: Scramble not available for this type.
scramble.randomMoveWarning: Note: random-move sequence with correct notation, not a random-state solver. Fine for training, not 100% comparable to competition. Random-state is being added step by step.

solveList.title: Solves
solveList.emptyNoFilter: No solves yet. Enter one above or import your csTimer data.
solveList.infoBody: All your solves in chronological order (newest first). Click a column header #/Time/AO5/AO12 to sort. Click on a time or note to edit inline. The ℹ button per row shows scramble + hardware + session details.
solveList.limitTitle: Maximum number of solves to show
solveList.tipFooter: Tip: click a column header (#, Time, AO5, AO12) to sort · click a time to edit · ℹ for details (scramble, note, hardware, session). Enter saves, Esc cancels.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.infoEmpty: Lists cubes you haven't touched for more than {{days}} days. Sorted: most-forgotten first. Considers all active hardware cubes (Settings → Hardware).
reminders.infoActive: Cubes you haven't touched for more than {{days}} days. Click a row to set your timer cube filter — quick jump into training.
reminders.allFresh: All cubes trained within the last {{days}} days. ✅

recentPbs.title: 🏆 Recent records
recentPbs.emptyText: No personal bests yet — as soon as you save solves, your latest single / ao5 / ao12 PBs will appear here along with the improvement over the previous PB.
recentPbs.infoBody: Your latest personal bests across all cubes. Gold ★ = single PB, cyan ● = ao5 PB, emerald ● = ao12 PB. The Δ value shows how much you beat the previous PB. Click a row to open the PB history in the Analysis tab.
recentPbs.clickHint: Click to open the PB history in the Analysis tab
recentPbs.deltaTitle: Improvement over the previous PB of the same metric

stats.title: Statistics
stats.noSolves: No solves match the current filter yet.
stats.infoText: Best single + best/current AO5/AO12/AO100 for the current selection (cube + session). WCA-compliant: +2 counts as time+2s, DNF is trimmed from averages. "Best AO5" = best AO5 ever achieved across all solves; "current AO5" = the last 5.

timer.errorInvalidTime: Invalid time (or leave field empty for DNF)
timer.plusTwoNotPossibleOnDnf: Not possible on DNF solve (remove DNF first)
timer.dnfMarkRemovesPlusTwo: Mark as DNF — existing +2 will be removed automatically (WCA: not combinable)
